sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद् यद्यस्ति मयि संभ्रमः ।किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षयं नयति राक्षसान् ।। ५.३८.४५।।।।
transliteration: tasya vīryavataḥ kaścid yadyasti mayi saṁbhramaḥ ।kimarthaṁ na śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣayaṁ nayati rākṣasān ।। 5.38.45।।।।

translations.english: "Does Rama have a little anxiety about me? If he has, why does he, a disciplined hero, not put an end to the demons with his sharp arrows?
